name: Palm tree
style: low-poly, flat colours, curved segmented trunk under a crown of faceted fronds (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static palm tree on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is PalmTree_1 from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip as the tree, tree-pine, tree-autumn and bush entries, so they read as one set. Of the four palms in the pack it has the fullest crown (more than a dozen fronds, 5.2 x 4.7 m) on the classic S-curved coconut-palm trunk; PalmTree_3 is straighter and thinner-crowned, PalmTree_4 has only eight fronds, and PalmTree_2 leans so far that its base sits 3.5 m off the crown's centre. The fronds are closed shells (a doubleSided render was identical), so they are not double-sided. Its Coconuts material is buried in the crown and never shows, so it maps to trunk. Height 8 m: a coconut palm on a beach or resort promenade is 6-10 m when young to mid-age (old ones reach 20-30 m); at 8 m the fronds spring from about 7 m and droop to 5.5 m, high over a 1.6 m person, as in an anime beach or island background. Colours on meadow: fronds the mid green (iris) shading to the deep green (hair), a richer green than the willow's light foliage; the trunk is pale skin-tan shading to vermilion (accent). Meadow has no brown: of its non-green pairs, skin over accent gives the clearest two-tone on the thin trunk and the warmest, closest read of a sun-bleached palm trunk (skin over practical and practical over skin barely separate, and moon over skin is the willow's trunk). The red shade is a little hot up close. Static: no clips.
